# Step - date_diff

`date_diff` · `dateDiff` · category: [Dates and times](../../traversal/step_reference.md#dates-and-times)

Difference in milliseconds (TinkerPop dateDiff()) or whole DT units.

## Forms

```text
date_diff(arg1: any)
date_diff(arg1: any, arg2: DT)
date_diff(arg1: any, arg2: DT, arg3: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(time("10:00")).date_diff(time("09:00"), DT.hour).next()   // 1
```
